title: Oore pipeline file, version 2
description: A `.oore.yaml` pipeline file in format version 2. Reference: https://docs.oore.build/reference/config/oore-yaml-v2. Check a file against your instance with `oore pipeline validate`.

name.description: Display name for a pipeline Oore adds from this file. Defaults to the file's path.

app.description: The Flutter app: its Flutter version and flavors.

flutter.description: Flutter version, such as 3.24.5. Quote it when YAML would read it as a number. A `.fvmrc` file takes precedence.

flavors.description: Flavor matrix. Each target builds once per flavor. Names use letters, digits, `-` and `_`.

targets.description: What to build per platform. Required unless every workflow names its own targets.

steps.description: Steps in order. `build` marks where the targets build. Defaults to `[build]`.

env.description: Environment variables for every step. Values may use `${{ vars.NAME }}` and `${{ secrets.NAME }}`. At most 128.

vars.description: Values to reuse with `${{ vars.NAME }}`. Vars can refer to other vars. At most 128.

on.description: When builds start. Left out, the pipeline's trigger settings in Oore apply.

workflows.description: Named variants of the build, such as `adhoc` and `release`, each with its own triggers, targets, steps and signing.

signing.description: Signing identities from the app's signing library, by name. Every workflow uses them unless it names its own.

runs_on.description: Runner labels a runner must have to take the build. One label or a list. Defaults to `[macos]`.

isolation.description: Where the steps run: `host` (default) directly on the runner, or `vm` in a fresh macOS VM.

build_number_offset.description: Added to Oore's build number to give the app's build number. Defaults to 0.

release_notes.description: Where the release notes live in the repository. Set `changelog` or `dir`, not both.

changelog.description: A Markdown changelog such as `CHANGELOG.md`. The section headed with the app version, such as `## [2.5.1]`, is used.

dir.description: A directory with one `<locale>.txt` per language, or fastlane's `<locale>/release_notes.txt`.

build.description: The complete build command for the platform, such as `flutter build appbundle --release`. Oore adds nothing to it.

artifacts.description: Glob patterns for the files to keep. Defaults to the platform's usual outputs.

publish.description: Where the build is uploaded. `false` uploads nothing, also in a workflow that would inherit a publish.

budgets.description: Artifact size limits for the commit check, on top of the pipeline's size budget.

play.description: Upload to Google Play. Android targets only.

rollout.description: Staged rollout fraction, greater than 0 and at most 1, such as 0.05 for 5%. Left out, the Google Play settings decide.

draft.description: `true` creates a draft release in Play Console instead of rolling out. Left out, the Google Play settings decide.

service_account.description: Name of the secret holding the Google service account JSON key.

testflight.description: Upload to TestFlight. Same as `app_store: { destination: testflight, groups: [group] }`. iOS targets only.

group.description: The TestFlight group: one name, without commas, at most 128 characters.

app_store.description: Upload to App Store Connect. Fields left out keep the pipeline's App Store settings. iOS targets only.

destination.description: `app_store` (default) attaches the build to the App Store version; `testflight` adds it to TestFlight groups.

submit_for_review.description: Submit the version for App Review, for destination app_store.

phased_release.description: Release with Apple's seven-day phased release, for destination app_store.

release_type.description: When Apple releases the approved version: `after_approval` (default), `manual` or `scheduled`.

earliest_release_date.description: RFC 3339 time a scheduled release goes out, such as 2026-12-01T09:00:00Z. Only with release_type scheduled.

release_notes_dir.description: Repository directory with "What's New" per locale, as `<locale>.txt` or fastlane's `<locale>/release_notes.txt`.

cancel_previous_submission.description: `true` cancels another open App Review submission before submitting.

preflight.description: What a failed pre-flight check does: `auto` (default) warns until the store has accepted a release, then blocks; `block`, `warn` or `off`.

mode.description: `fail` fails the check when an artifact is over; `warn` (default) only says so.

rules.description: Limits per artifact kind. At most 20. Empty turns the budget off.

kind.description: The artifact's lowercase file extension, such as `aab`, `apk` or `ipa`.

max_bytes.description: Largest size allowed, in bytes. Greater than 0.

max_increase_bytes.description: Largest growth over the baseline build, in bytes. 0 or more.

max_increase_percent.description: Largest growth over the baseline build, in percent. 0 or more.

android.description: Name of an Android keystore in the app's signing library. It signs release builds.

ios.description: Name of an iOS distribution identity in the app's signing library: a certificate and its profiles.

oneOf.description: `build`, where the targets build, or in a workflow the name of a top-level step.

name.description: The step's name, shown in the build log.

tests.description: Path to the step's test results, such as `flutter test --machine` output.

branches.description: Branch names or globs, such as `main` or `release/*`.

pull_request.description: Build pull and merge requests: `true`, or `{ branches: [...] }` for their target branches.

tag.description: Build tags matching a glob, such as `v*`. One pattern or a list.

paths.description: Only build when a changed file matches one of these globs.

on.description: When this workflow runs. Replaces the top-level `on`.

targets.description: A list of platforms picks top-level targets; a mapping overrides them per field.

steps.description: Replaces the top-level steps. Entries can name top-level steps.

env.description: Adds to or replaces top-level env values by name.

vars.description: Adds to or replaces top-level vars by name.

signing.description: Signing identities for this workflow, replacing the top-level `signing` per platform.
